notes: gifts-2.js contains no hardcoded business data; it is pure DOM wiring (cart-count sync, mobile-nav active state, mega-dropdown hover logic).

gifts.js contains ALL hardcoded business data for the gifts/personalised-gifts page, embedded in an IIFE with several sub-views (home / category / product / customise / checkout) sharing overlapping but not identical product datasets.

GALLERY_ROOT is the common Cloudinary base URL prefix ('https://res.cloudinary.com/ismg8jfl/image/upload/sai_kumar_studio/gifts-assets/') used to resolve relative filenames in PRODUCT_GALLERIES into full image URLs.

There are TWO near-duplicate CATEGORY_META/PRODUCTS blocks in gifts.js (one for the 'product' detail view ~line 3580, one for the 'customise' view ~line 4356). They differ slightly in a handful of prices/names (e.g. 'Velvet Heart Photo Cushion' vs 'Premium Velvet Heart Photo Cushion', differing crystal-cube prices). Both are preserved separately for traceability as PRODUCT_VIEW_PRODUCTS and CUSTOMISE_VIEW_PRODUCTS.

No coupon/discount-code or hero-carousel-slide JS data objects were found; the home-page hero carousel markup lives in static HTML (.hero-slide elements), not in JS data. The only banner/carousel-style JS data present is the 'personalizedSlides' promotions fallback block.

All prices in this file are plain numbers (rupees) in the source, e.g. price: 699 — NOT pre-formatted strings. The 'money'/'rupees' helper functions format them as '₹1,499' at render time. Numbers are preserved as-is; formatted equivalents are not fabricated.

VARIANT_PRICING._source: gifts.js: inline price/oldPrice lookup tables used inside updateCustomisePrice() and cartItem() on the customise view (~line 5303-5407). These are size/shape variant surcharge tables layered on top of a product's base price, functioning like package tiers for frames, acrylic frames, and wall clocks.

COUPONS_AND_OFFERS._source: No hardcoded coupon/discount-code data structures were found in gifts.js or gifts-2.js. The only price reduction shown is the per-product 'off' percentage label (e.g. '30% OFF') already captured on each item in PRODUCTS/PRODUCT_VIEW_PRODUCTS/CUSTOMISE_VIEW_PRODUCTS, computed as (old - price).

HERO_BANNER_DATA._source: No JS array/object of hero-carousel slide data (images/titles/taglines) specific to gifts.html was found. The '#heroTrack .hero-slide' elements are static HTML markup manipulated by goToHero()/moveHero()/initHeroCarousel() in gifts.js (~line 2761-2800+), not JS-defined data. The nearest thing to hero/promo data is PERSONALIZED_SHOWCASE_FALLBACK above (the 'Personalized Gifts' promo module with its 'featured' and 'promotions' slides).
